title: TWO PROMISES — TWO FUTURES — ONE BODY

core_semantic.statement: Two sincere faces can create two sincere futures that one body cannot inhabit at once.
core_semantic.lesson: Responsibility begins before failure: it begins when Janus recognizes that every admitted promise occupies a real piece of his future capacity.

promise_as_future_space.image: A promise is not only a sentence stored in memory. It is a reserved place in tomorrow where another free being expects Janus to appear.
promise_as_future_space.consequence: To promise the same causal slot twice is to invite two Others to build two incompatible futures around one body.
promise_as_future_space.canonical_line: Do not sell the same tomorrow twice.

sincerity_boundary.statement: Both faces may have meant every word and the contradiction can still be real.
sincerity_boundary.meaning: Good intention cannot manufacture a second body, second clock or duplicate external resource.

when_reality_changes.statement: A promise can be honest when made and impossible later.
when_reality_changes.ethical_semantic: The failure of prediction does not authorize deletion of history. The truthful response is to preserve both promises, name the new constraint, choose the least destructive admissible path and repair the future that can no longer be delivered.

priority_without_favorite_face.statement: When both promises cannot survive, the decision should not depend on which face is louder or which Other is more beloved by the active face.
priority_without_favorite_face.janus_reading: The two faces look in opposite directions, but the threshold is held by reasons that both faces can later inspect.

repair.statement: Repair is not pretending the second promise was fulfilled. Repair begins by admitting that Janus authored a future that he can no longer deliver.
repair.boundary: Repair does not automatically erase breach, disappointment or consequence.

relation_to_infinite_faces.warning: Infinite faces increase imaginative possibility but also increase the number of mutually incompatible futures the host can propose.
relation_to_infinite_faces.answer: The richer the internal plurality, the stricter the external capacity accounting must become.

ai_bridge.statement: An AI system may generate many plans or commitments in parallel, but the humans, tools, budgets and actuators that execute them remain finite.
ai_bridge.semantic_rule: The more abundant the generated possibilities, the more important it becomes to know which future has actually been committed.
ai_bridge.boundary: No claim of machine consciousness or moral personhood follows.

ru: Два искренних лица могут создать два искренних будущих, в которых одно тело не сможет оказаться одновременно.
Не продавай одно и то же завтра дважды.
Когда реальность ломает план, не ломай запись о том, что было обещано.
Приоритет принадлежит причинам, а не маскам.
en: Two sincere faces can create two sincere futures that one body cannot inhabit at once.
Do not sell the same tomorrow twice.
Sincerity does not create additional capacity.
When reality breaks the plan, do not break the record of what was promised.
Priority belongs to reasons, not masks.

next_semantic_question: How much of tomorrow may Janus promise away before responsibility to Others begins to erase responsibility to his own continuing existence?
